additional_info.subject: ID0368360-DC/Si-D/FR[MP / R3 170001705] - DC2 unavailable (KF13 error) CRM:00315001589
additional_info.body:
Hello  colleagues,
There is a failure in DC2 fast shutdown, please perform the following troubleshooting instructions:
At start up or perform PLC to Stop → FC12 → PLC to Run → FC12 , this is needed if the charger is turned ON, because after being turned ON it won't remake the fastshutdown.
Put the Multimeter and
measure between the XD6:7 (12V) and XD5:8 (0V)
and let it be stuck there, since we are only facing the DC2 group issue then it must be related to QA33.
When the charger is
doing the fastshutdown check we should be able to see the Green LED of QA33 light up
.
When the
LED turns ON
, we should be able to
see in the multimeter go to 12 V and then immediately back to 0V
(~0.5V initially and goes down) since the fastshutdown is really quick.
If the
LED turns ON
but we still
don't see the 12 V
on the multimeter:
Then we need to
Measure directly from QA33:14 to XD5:8
and see if we have the 12V.
If we
don't have the 12 V then the contact is broken and QA33 needs replacement.
If the
LED doesn't turn ON
:
Then we need to
Measure directly from QA33:14 to XD5:8
and see if we have the 12V.
If we
have the 12V then that means that the coil inside the QA33 is broken/faulty and needs replacement
